members.destinations: legal cells empty at that step, other than the object's own cell (vacated cells reusable)
members.objects: every non-target object not in fixed_ids, each relocated at most once

never_reads: construction (options, intended, K_intent, K_LB, K_cert, forced_order, neutral_cells, harmful_cells, q_ref_footprint)
size: 1 + sum_m P(n, m) F^m, F = |legal cells| - |objects| when every object rests on a legal cell

never_pruned: terminal connector failure of a prefix
sound_rules.subtree_success: relocated object on the goal -> every extension GOAL_BLOCKED (single-move contract)
sound_rules.terminal: GOAL_BLOCKED -> success 0 (no teacher label is ever created from it)
